name: Cauliflower Rice Italian Sausage Casserole

dupe_check.catalog: Not a catalog duplicate. All catalog pork/Italian-sausage dishes are pasta, soup, or potato based (Italian Sausage Penne with Peppers, Italian Sausage Minestrone, Sausage Bake with Potatoes, etc.); none is a grain-free cauliflower-rice + mushroom + mozzarella bake.
dupe_check.pool: No colliding pork-sausage candidate in my three-item set.
dupe_check.accepted_slugs: Checked fresh - 'italian-sausage-peppers-onions-skillet' (accepted) is a peppers/onions skillet with no cauliflower-rice bake base; 'chicken-bacon-ranch-cauliflower-bake' (accepted) is a different protein and ranch/bacon flavor. Neither is this dish.

cross_protein_collisions: Structural cousin to catalog 'Cheesy Turkey Sausage and Vegetable Rice Casserole' - same sausage + veg + cheese casserole concept, but that is turkey sausage on a real-rice base while this is pork Italian sausage on cauliflower rice. Different protein and different starch. Decider should watch for another selector proposing a turkey-Italian-sausage cauliflower-rice bake, which WOULD be a near-duplicate.
evidence: 506 cal / 8.5g carbs from source card; catalog Italian-sausage dishes are all pasta/potato/soup; the only sausage cauliflower/veg casserole cousin is turkey + real rice.
